plain_english: Bow to master Soma — desire withdrawn, longing stretched, moon-crested.
sanskrit_cite: upasaṃhṛtakāmāya kāmāyatim atanvate avataṃsitasomāya somāya svāmine namaḥ

plain_english: 'What can I, incapable, do?' — for one who resolves nothing anywhere: Śaṅkara's all-befriending power is my refuge.
sanskrit_cite: kim aśaktaḥ karomīti sarvatrānadhyavasyataḥ sarvānugrāhikā śaktiḥ śāṃkarī śaraṇaṃ mama

plain_english: Of you beyond guṇas, whose self is described as utter excellence — in which part, O Bhava, is a substitute for you found?
sanskrit_cite: guṇātītasya nirdiṣṭaniḥśeṣātiśayātmanaḥ labhyate bhava kutrāṃśe paraḥ pratinidhis tava

plain_english: Though you, the self, are nondual and limitless, O lord — even now we are cheated by your unmeasured māyā.
sanskrit_cite: nirdvandve nirupādhau ca tvayy ātmani sati prabho vayaṃ vañcyāmahe 'dyāpi māyayāmeyayā tava

plain_english: Attainment of powers from aṇimā onward, eternal lordship, end of becoming — these, O Bhava, are sprouts of the wish-tree of devotion to you.
sanskrit_cite: aṇimādiguṇāvāptiḥ sadaiśvaryaṃ bhavakṣayaḥ amī bhava bhavadbhaktikalpapādapapallavāḥ

plain_english: Whatever quarter, there you are never absent; all time is made of you — thus already won, yet when will you be won, O lord? Tell.
sanskrit_cite: yā yā dik tatra na kvāsi sarvaḥ kālo bhavanmayaḥ iti labdho 'pi karhi tvaṃ lapsyase nātha kathyatām

plain_english: Bow to Śambhu — sole dweller in clear good hearts, white-limbed with much ash, great swan.
sanskrit_cite: namaḥ prasannasadvṛttamānasaikanivāsine bhūribhūtisitāṅgāya mahāhaṃsāya śambhave

plain_english: Dispersing surging darkness, having burned all becoming-fuel — may your awareness-lamp be mine, O lord — your devotion-lamp.
sanskrit_cite: hṛtoddhatatamastāntiḥ pluṣṭāśeṣabhavendhanā tvadbodhadīpikā me 'stu nātha tvadbhaktidīpikā

plain_english: Having staged the three-world-play pregnant with many true emitted seeds — O Hara, to dissolve it, who but you is a capable poet?
sanskrit_cite: visṛṣṭānekasadbījagarbhaṃ trailokyanāṭakam prastāvya hara saṃhartuṃ tvattaḥ ko 'nyaḥ kaviḥ kṣamaḥ

plain_english: Bow to make real-and-unreal into non-being or being indeed — to free and unfree, to embodying-expenditure-and-dominion.
sanskrit_cite: namaḥ sadasatāṃ kartum asattvaṃ sattvam eva vā svatantrāyāsvatantrāya vyayaiśvaryaikaśāline

plain_english: Whatever bliss at all is seen here even in three worlds — that is a drop of whom: to that god, bliss-ocean, I bow.
sanskrit_cite: trailokye 'py atra yo yāvān ānandaḥ kaścid īkṣyate sa bindur yasya taṃ vande devam ānandasāgaram

plain_english: Ah, blessed are Brahmā and the others who, having dropped all other talk, mutter overwhelmed with joy: homage, homage to Śiva.
sanskrit_cite: aho brahmādayo dhanyā ye vimuktānyasaṃkatham namo namaḥ śivāyeti japanty āhlādavihvalāḥ

plain_english: To the desireless yet ordainer of endless desires; even in the world's beginninglessness, to the enjoyer — O Bhava, let bow be to you.
sanskrit_cite: niṣkāmāyāpi kāmānām anantānāṃ vidhāyine anāditve 'pi viśvasya bhoktre bhava namo 'stu te

plain_english: We praise the lord, root-nature of three-world beginning — who would seek any service from him, since of perfect nature?
sanskrit_cite: stumas tribhuvanārambhamūlaprakṛtim īśvaram lipseran nopakāraṃ ke yataḥ sampūrṇadharmaṇaḥ

plain_english: Even in great hard straits, dirtied by delusion-flood — when he is remembered, minds clear: that Śiva we praise.
sanskrit_cite: mahatsv apy arthakṛcchreṣu mohaughamalinīkṛtāḥ smṛte yasmin prasīdanti matayas taṃ śivaṃ stumaḥ

plain_english: O lord, from you alone here sovereign power unbroken — by whose will the three worlds' dissolution and rise unfold.
sanskrit_cite: prabho bhavata eveha prabhuśaktir abhaṅgurā yadicchayā pratāyete trailokyasya layodayau

plain_english: Even evil deed aimed at which god would become supreme good; even good deed's goodness — since elsewhere you are not so, O!
sanskrit_cite: kukarmāpi yam uddiśya devaṃ syāt sukṛtaṃ param sukṛtasyāpi saukṛtyaṃ yato 'nyatra na so 'si bhoḥ

plain_english: 'Seized by fist you are, seen you are — where go you from us?' — thus, puffed with devotion-rasa, the blessed run to Dhūrjaṭi.
sanskrit_cite: eṣa muṣṭyā gṛhīto 'si dṛṣṭa eṣa kva yāsi naḥ iti bhaktirasādhmātā dhanyā dhāvanti dhūrjaṭim

plain_english: We praise you — of Ṛk, Yajus, Sāman, from bright, from beyond, beyond — whose Veda-embodied knowable — ah, deep-lovely.
sanskrit_cite: stumas tvām ṛgyajuḥsāmnāṃ śukrataḥ parataḥ param yasya vedātmikājñeyam aho gambhīrasundarī

plain_english: Rule, beginning, so end you are of the world, O Supreme Lord — the dharma-multitude set forth: which is not from you — from where would it be?
sanskrit_cite: vidhir ādis tathānto 'si viśvasya parameśvara dharmagrāmaḥ pravṛtto yas tvatto na sa kuto bhavet
